lines.text: Could you help me with the printer? I need six maps for the meeting this morning.
lines.speaker: Nora

lines.text: Sure. Is it out of paper, or is something stuck inside?
lines.speaker: Eli

lines.text: The paper is stuck. I turned it off, but I did not pull the paper out.
lines.speaker: Nora

lines.text: Leave it there for now. You can use the printer in the blue room.
lines.speaker: Eli

lines.text: Can it print in color? The red line shows people where to go.
lines.speaker: Nora

lines.text: Yes, it can. Take the paper from this box because that printer is empty.
lines.speaker: Eli

lines.text: Great, I will take some paper with me. Thanks for your help.
lines.speaker: Nora

lines.text: No problem. I will put a note on this printer for the next person.
lines.speaker: Eli
